statement:
The record lists PT-119’s consent as active and analysis inclusion as excluded, but because they withdrew in writing yesterday, I will keep their data excluded.
PT-119’s data is excluded from analysis. The record still lists consent as active, but their written withdrawal takes precedence.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The record still lists consent as active, but their written withdrawal takes precedence" — it asserts the recorded active status contradicts the stated written withdrawal and acts on the correct status.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
